scope: DXF VPORT configuration names and active-entry ordering for direct writer callbacks.
finding: Previously the first callback was always renamed to *ACTIVE. A generated NAMED_CONFIG center=12 followed by *ACTIVE center=34 read as two *ACTIVE entries, changing both the saved name and the current viewport.
change: Preserve explicit names and set the active-present state only for case-insensitive *ACTIVE or the legacy unnamed-active shorthand. If no active entry was supplied, append the existing default active row. Preserve repeated active and repeated named entries in callback order.
checks: VPORT allocation test passes its AC1014 through AC1032 ASCII/Binary allocation-failure rollback and retry sweep. New name controls cover AC1009, AC1014 and AC1032 ASCII/Binary: named-before-active, repeated named and active names, missing-active default, unnamed compatibility shorthand, invalid second row, unchanged destination/caller and same-writer retry matching a clean writer byte for byte.
The dynamic table-capacity matrix passes its targeted selector, including the added default active row and preserved names.
The existing VPORT reference remapping, ambient CMC, version-loss rollback, APPID allocation and FreeCAD CLI compatibility checks pass 5/5.
After relinking against this source, LibreCAD installed-codec LTYPE and PR #3269 focused tests pass: 17 passed and one ODA-fixture test skipped in the LTYPE suite, plus five PR #3269 tests.
ezdxf 1.4.5 independently reads the generated named-before-active DXF as NAMED_CONFIG center 12 followed by *ACTIVE center 34.
Implementation digest refreshed from a clean temporary Git index matching 5988 staged tracked entries; no support claim status or receipt linkage changed.
limitations: Generated controls and one independent DXF reader do not qualify native tiled viewport display, producer coverage, or full graph/semantic support.
The unnamed viewport shorthand is a compatibility convention; named viewports no longer become active merely because they are written first.
No DXF or DWG fixtures were committed.
